$comment: New residents who can move in after a death (docs/10). A card is used only once its status is 'reviewed' (the project owner reviews every card for stereotypes and dignity first, docs/06). 'room' is filled in when they move in. Sprite: chosen by gender until their own character is generated.

resident.origin: Born in Mombasa, Kenya; came to Leicester in 1972 with her husband and two small children
life_story: Trained as a primary school teacher in Mombasa
Came to Leicester in 1972 and worked for 25 years in a hosiery factory, then as a classroom assistant
Married Ramesh in 1962; widowed in 2021; lived with her daughter's family until her falls became frequent
Led the women's bhajan group at the temple on Belgrave Road for 20 years
Taught all six grandchildren to cook dhokla
resident.speech_style: Warm and chatty, mixes Gujarati and English, calls younger staff 'beta', likes to ask about people's families

capacity.treatment: can make most decisions with time and explanation

nutrition.diet: lacto-vegetarian (no meat, fish or eggs); diabetic

preferences: prays at her small shrine by the window each morning
prefers female carers for personal care
large-print or audio: she can't read small print

legal.dnacpr_note: Not discussed yet; to be raised with Kamala and her daughter

goals: settle in and make a friend
go to the temple for Diwali
triggers: people talking about her rather than to her

visitors.name: Hema Mistry
visit_behaviours: brings home-cooked food in a tiffin
checks her mother's hearing aid and glasses
